intro.text: The middle son of Rivershore's reeve, Matin, and his wife Rema; as the reeve's son, he is expected to be well schooled.

items.text: In the life December lived before waking in the past, Torrent was six when his mother died, and with no one to steer him he ran wild around town. He was fifteen when his father married December, who shamed him into taking up his lessons again, and like his brothers he groaned whenever she called him cute. He grew up to marry and have at least one child, but the plague killed him and all his family, sparing only December.
